piv_error_stats — PIV assess op

• Data kinds: flow2d × flow2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.piv_error_stats(flow, truth, trim=1) (to call the implementation directly, import pivops; pivops.piv_error_stats(flow, truth, trim=1); from the registry, opspiv.get("piv_error_stats"))

Usage

Breakdown of the difference from the ground truth. Returns bias and scatter separately.

Reporting only one of them lets an implementation with a systematic offset pass as "error 0.3 px". Bias (mean error) and scatter (standard deviation) point to different causes.

Args:

flow: estimate (2, h, w).

truth: ground truth on the same grid (2, h, w) (the return of piv_sample_at_windows).

trim: number of grid cells removed from the outer edge. Correlation drops when a window touches the image border, so

by default 1 ring is dropped. 0 means the whole grid.

Returns:

dict: bias_dy / bias_dx / std_dy / std_dx / rms

(root mean square of the 2 components combined) / median_abs / p95_abs /

n_valid / n_total.
